name: conductor-merge-gates
description: NOUS.CONDUCTOR.MERGE_GATES.1 — live staging-HEAD merge invariant. Fetches the origin/staging tip from the GitHub REST API immediately before every PATCH merge request; fetch failure = hard abort; 409 = merge_conflict logged, clause not advanced. NOUS.CONDUCTOR.MERGE_GATES.2 — post-merge two-phase build gate (tsc --noEmit then production bundle build) runs against the merged staging checkout; either phase non-zero = clause not advanced to shipped. NOUS.CONDUCTOR.MERGE_GATES.3 — pre-swap smoke gate serves the freshly built dist/ on a temporary local port, verifies index HTTP 200, and runs a headless mount check for console errors; only on smoke_passed does swapDist atomically replace the served dist/; on failure the existing dist/ is preserved and the clause is marked verification_pending with a decision_queue row.
